items.author: ellioclips
items.context: EllioTrades Clips comparte un clip de EllioTrades: dice que ballenas de Bitcoin mueven sus monedas a BlackRock por miedo a hackeos, que la autocustodia no es para todos y que la mayoría estaría mejor teniendo su Bitcoin en la bolsa; cita: "Self custody was not necessarily a mistake, but it absolutely caused much more pain than it saved over the years".
items.suggested_text: Self-custody hurts when people improvise it. But the answer to hacking fear is a better setup, not handing the keys back: a fund share is a claim on $BTC, not $BTC you control. I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup step by step: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: 0xPhilanthrop
items.context: Philanthrop publica un "roadmap" mes a mes para BTC 2026-2027 tras caer bajo $74K: noviembre miedo a optimismo, diciembre rally y euforia, enero complacencia, febrero ansiedad, marzo capitulación; advierte que la trampa será creer que solo puede subir.
items.suggested_text: Month-by-month roadmaps are fun, but the month is the part nobody can know. What I find more useful is where $BTC sits versus its long-term power law trend: it tells you if price is cheap or stretched, not when the top comes. How I read that trend: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279
